description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator module, which validates system command execution configurations. It includes test cases for command contract compliance, raw command parsing, and environment variable handling, along with methods to load fixtures and locate necessary JSON data files.

classes.name: ExecSystemRunCommandValidatorTests
classes.description: A test suite class containing multiple unit tests for the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator component, testing command validation, parsing, and integration with fixtures.

methods.name: loadContractCases
methods.description: Loads test fixture cases from a JSON file located via a dynamic search, and decodes them into test case objects.

methods.name: findContractFixtureURL
methods.description: Searches up to 8 directory levels from the current file location to locate the 'system-run-command-contract.json' fixture file, throwing an error if not found.
